title: 第4章 崩山拳
content_zh:
陆凡坐在小院中，呼吸吐纳，将体内的浊气缓缓排出。

他是在为吃聚力丹做准备，他只有这么一颗珍贵的丹药，所以他必须要将丹药的最大效果发挥出来。

待到一切调整至巅峰，陆凡才拿出聚力丹服下。

丹药入口即化，化作一股清流涌入身体之中。

下一刻，陆凡感觉到了自己的身体如遭蚂蚁啃食一般，痛楚在向四肢百骸蔓延。

陆凡不知这是不是正常现象，但比这更加剧烈的痛苦也都忍受过，这点痛，不算什么。

由他的丹田处开始，温暖的力量游走不停。陆凡有种喝了老吴的酒的错觉，想到这，不由得轻笑一声，但旋即，陆凡立马集中注意力。

此时可不是能够分心的时候，感受着热浪在经脉之中流动，一点一点减弱。

而随着热浪的游走，陆凡能清晰的感觉到自己的身体强壮了起来。

痛楚消失，取而代之的是全身充满力量。

肉体在以飞快的速度增强，凝实的肌肉，坚韧的经脉，强壮有力的五脏六腑。

陆凡此时已经进入了内视的状态之中，他看到了自己身体的变化，目睹了自己变得强大的身躯，与原来完全两样。

陆凡震惊了，倘若这就仅仅只是一颗丹药带来的改变。那丹药的作用也是在太过逆天了一些。

陆凡还记得几天前他进入内视状态看自己身躯的场景，与现在简直天差地别。

陆凡知道，这是药力被吸收完毕的表现。原来吃药材的时候，也是这样。

缓缓吐出一口气，陆凡活动了一下身躯，眼眸之中有光芒亮起。

原本瘦弱的他，此时仿佛忽的强壮了不少，整个人都看起来健康许多。

身体强度几乎比原来增长了一倍，力量不知强了多少，但肯定也是一倍有余。

陆凡站起身，马步扎好，对着练功石一记重拳。

拳头带起破风声，砸在练功石上。清脆的碎裂声响起，碎石飞溅，陆凡一拳将练功石打出一个深深的拳印，碎裂的纹络扩展开来。

笑看着自己的拳头，果然自己的力量有了大幅度的提升。

仔细比较今天白天打出的拳印在与这个拳印比较，陆凡感觉自己的力量不止提升了一倍，就是不知道，自己现在是炼体四重，还是炼体五重了。

陆凡轻声笑了起来，笑声在夜空中游荡。

良久，笑声渐收，陆凡决定去测验一下自己的实力到底如何，并且顺便，他也正式需要一套武技了。

一般练武之人，到了炼体四重之后，都需要一套武技来修炼，毕竟光有力量，不会武技，不过是一个空有蛮力的莽夫。

陆家作为武道世家，有着一个颇大的藏书阁楼，里面摆满了各种武技，只要是陆家子弟就可进去阅览。

虽然大多都是低级武技，好一点的人级武技都少有，超过人级武技的灵级武技更是只听说过陆家绝学烈火金身。但对于陆凡这种修为不高，罡劲都还未练出的人来说，最低的人级武技就已经够了。

迈步往藏书阁楼走，走过陆家后院，顺着花园小路，蜿蜒前行，陆凡来到了藏书阁楼外。此时已然是半夜，一路上除了见到几个守卫的家丁，再没有见到任何认识的人。

藏书阁楼的门口，立着一块一人来高的墨石。

陆凡来此的目的之一，就是试验一下自己的实力到底如何。而评定修为等级最准确的东西，就是被武道强者改造过的墨石。

陆凡走到墨石前，屏气凝神，然后猛然一拳击出。

拳劲打在墨石之上，下一刻墨石亮起一层光芒。

看到炼体五重几个大字，陆凡顿时兴奋的挥了挥拳头。

一天连升两重，这等进步，简直逆天。如果不是怕吵醒其他人，陆凡此时就想仰天长啸。

平复了一下情绪，陆凡推开了藏书阁楼的大门。

一眼，陆凡就看到了坐在门旁看着书籍的老者，陆凡恭敬的叫了一声：“寻老。”

这名老者，是陆家藏书阁楼的看守者。陆凡也不明白为什么会让寻老这样走都快走不动的老人家来看守阁楼。

寻老抬头看了陆凡一眼，道：“来找武技的？陆凡，你到炼体四重了？”

陆凡对于寻老居然能叫出他的名字感到略微有些惊讶，毕竟他好几年没有来藏书阁楼了。上一次来，也是匆匆忙忙的看了一圈，然后发现自己根本没有练这些武技的可能，就失望离去了。

寻老点点头道：“嗯。左手边开始，依次是刀法，剑法，拳法，身法，最右边是杂书，还没分类。你自己挑吧，挑好了，拿过来到我这登记一下。”

陆凡躬身应是，接着便兴奋的开始挑选武技。

刀法，剑法他暂时不想练。因为他们陆家最强的是身法，所以要学的话，肯定是先从身法跟拳法入手，这两种都属于肉搏强身武技，练好了，也算是为修炼陆家最强的烈火金身打基础。

虽然陆凡对自己以后能不能练到烈火金身还是有些怀疑，但提前做准备总是没错的，就像原来他也没有想过自己能在十八岁前修炼到炼体五重，这几乎已经是陆家年轻一辈的平均水平了。

人世间太多意外，充满惊喜，谁知道下一刻又将如何呢。

先来到身法架前，陆凡开始一本一本的挑选。这里的身法，大多都是一些基础的步伐闪躲，与横练身体的武技，效果一般。有一些，陆凡甚至已经在其他人身上看到过了，基本就是个花架式。

挑来挑去，陆凡也没有看到一本想要的，不由得有些失望，只能再去看拳法。

滚石拳，大力拳，蛮牛劲。。。。。。

这些功法看名字就知道很基础。陆凡翻看几十本依旧没有找到想要的。倘若他想在年祭的时候拿出点好成绩，现在他就必须找到一本比其他人强的武技。炼体五重并不能保证他不被外放，年祭最关键的一项是比试。倘若他的武技不行，将会被其他同等级的人，揍的很惨，而年祭也很快就要到了，也就还有一个月的时间。

陆凡需要的是能速成，威力不俗的武技。这种武技无疑也是其他人梦寐以求的，想要找到的可能性极其低。

翻了快一个时辰，陆凡也没有找到。失望的陆凡，走回寻老旁边道：“寻老，我想问能一个事，这里没有可以速成的武技吗？”

寻老放下手中的书，看着陆凡道：“年轻人，好高骛远可不是修武的正道。”

陆凡点头道：“我知道。但我的时间真的不多了，还有一个月就是年祭，希望寻老您能理解。”

寻老看向陆凡的眼睛，从陆凡的眼里，寻老看到了坚定。

这倒是一个有趣的小子！寻老心中想着。

顿了顿，寻老道：“能速成的武技到不是没有，只是这种武技一般没有人练而已，你想试试吗？”

陆凡眼前一亮，道：“想，非常想。”

寻老笑了，站起身，一瘸一拐的走到了墙角的杂书堆中。伸手，寻老从杂书的最下面抽出一本纸张已经泛黄的书籍。

步履蹒跚的走回，寻老将书递给陆凡道：“看看吧。”

陆凡接过书，映入眼帘的是三个大字。

听名字就很有气势，肯定有些门道。陆凡连忙打开书，仔细观看。

一看之下，不由得瞳孔一阵收缩，难怪没人练，这本武技，简直就是为练断胳膊而生的。

按照书上的描述，练崩山拳，首先要做的就是拿手臂拼命的砸石头，一天砸八个时辰，以各种不同的姿势砸，全力砸，一个月便可小成。

见陆凡不说话了，寻老笑着道：“怎么样，要练吗？这可是人级高阶武技，真要练出成果了，威力相当不错的。”

陆凡咬咬牙，他已经晚了人家好几年了，想要补上这其中的差距，不吃点苦怎么可能。

合上书，陆凡点头道：“就它了。寻老，帮我登记一下，我就要它了。”

“你确定？你看清楚是怎么修炼的吗？”

陆凡道：“看清楚了。武道一途，没有捷径，这点苦我想，我能吃下。”

寻老笑了，这么多年了，他还是第一次见到陆家小辈当中有这样坚韧不拔，不畏困苦的人。

虽然，实力一般，但心智，气魄相当不俗。

寻老道：“拿走吧。这本书给你了，不用登记。”

陆凡愣了一下，正欲出声。就在这时，门又被推开，一名女子走了进来，却是张月涵。

一眼，张月涵见到陆凡也在，顿时有些局促。

陆凡看了她一眼，然后收回了目光，对着寻老道：“多谢寻老，那我先走了。”

他来这干嘛，武技不是要练体四重才能修炼的吗？

正想着，寻老出声道：“女娃，你来干什么？你又不是陆家的人，藏书阁楼不许外人阅览。”

张月涵拿出腰间的一把剑道：“我是来帮陆明。。。。。”

话还未说完，寻老便接口道：“帮谁也不行，出去吧。夜已深了，早点休息。”

张月涵无奈走出了藏书阁楼，不甘的跺了跺脚。

转头，张月涵望着陆凡离去的方向，略有所思。

他来这里干什么，武技不是炼体四重以上才能修炼吗？

content_en:
Lu Fan sat in the small courtyard, breathing in and out, slowly expelling the turbid air from his body.

He was preparing to take the Juli Pill. He only had such a precious pill, so he had to maximize the effect of the pill.

When everything was adjusted to its peak, Lu Fan took out the Li Gathering Pill and drank it.

The elixir melts immediately in your mouth, turning into a clear stream and pouring into your body.

The next moment, Lu Fan felt as if his body was being eaten by ants, and the pain was spreading to his limbs and bones.

Lu Fan didn't know if this was normal, but he had endured more severe pain than this, so this little pain was nothing.

Starting from his Dantian, the warm power circulated non-stop.Lu Fan had the illusion that he had drunk Lao Wu's wine. Thinking of this, he couldn't help but chuckle, but immediately, Lu Fan concentrated his attention.

This is not the time to be distracted, feeling the heat waves flowing through the meridians, weakening little by little.

As the heat wave moved away, Lu Fan could clearly feel that his body was getting stronger.

The pain disappeared and was replaced by a feeling of strength throughout my body.

The body is strengthening at a rapid speed, with solid muscles, tough meridians, and strong internal organs.

Lu Fan had already entered a state of inner vision at this time. He saw the changes in his body and witnessed his body becoming stronger, which was completely different from the original one.

Lu Fan was shocked, if this was just a change brought about by a pill.The effect of the elixir is also a little too outrageous.

Lu Fan still remembers the scene when he entered the internal vision state to look at his body a few days ago. It was completely different from now.

Lu Fan knew that this was a sign that the medicine's power had been fully absorbed.It turns out that the same is true when taking medicinal herbs.

Slowly exhaling, Lu Fan moved his body, and a light lit up in his eyes.

He was originally thin, but now he seemed to have become much stronger, and his whole person looked much healthier.

The strength of the body has almost doubled compared to before, and the strength is unknown, but it is definitely more than doubled.

Lu Fan stood up, took a stance, and punched the training stone hard.

The fist made a breaking sound and hit the practice stone.There was a crisp cracking sound, and gravel flew. Lu Fan punched the training stone to make a deep punch mark, and the cracked lines spread.

Looking at his fists with a smile, his strength has indeed improved significantly.

After carefully comparing the punch marks made during the day with this one, Lu Fan felt that his strength had more than doubled, but he just didn't know whether he was at the fourth or fifth level of body refining.

Lu Fan laughed softly, and his laughter wandered in the night sky.

After a long time, the laughter gradually subsided, and Lu Fan decided to test his own strength, and by the way, he also officially needed a set of martial arts.

Generally, people who practice martial arts need a set of martial arts to practice after reaching the fourth level of body training. After all, if they only have strength but no martial arts, they are just a reckless man with no brute force.

As a martial arts family, the Lu family has a rather large library attic, which is filled with various martial arts. As long as the children of the Lu family can go in and read it.

Although most of them are low-level martial arts, better human-level martial arts are rare, and spiritual-level martial arts that surpass human-level martial arts have only been heard of, the Lu family's secret skill Fiery Golden Body.But for people like Lu Fan who are not very advanced and have not yet developed the strength, the lowest human-level martial arts is enough.

Stepping towards the library loft, walking through the Lu family's backyard and winding along the garden path, Lu Fan arrived outside the library loft.It was already midnight, and apart from a few guard servants, I didn't see anyone I knew along the way.

At the door of the library loft, there is a piece of ink stone as tall as a person.

One of the purposes of Lu Fan coming here is to test his own strength.The most accurate thing to evaluate the level of cultivation is the ink stone that has been transformed by a strong martial artist.

Lu Fan walked to the ink stone, held his breath and concentrated, and then punched out suddenly.

The fist hit the ink stone, and the next moment the ink stone lit up with a layer of light.

Seeing the words "Fifth Level of Body Refining", Lu Fan immediately waved his fist excitedly.

Lifting two levels in a row in one day, this kind of progress is simply unbelievable.If it weren't for the fear of waking up others, Lu Fan would have wanted to look up to the sky and scream.

After calming down, Lu Fan opened the door to the library loft.

At a glance, Lu Fan saw the old man sitting by the door and reading a book. Lu Fan respectfully called out: "Xun Lao."

This old man is the caretaker of the Lu family's library attic.Lu Fan didn't understand why an old man like Xun Lao, who could hardly walk, was allowed to guard the attic.

Xun Lao raised his head and glanced at Lu Fan, and said, "Are you looking for martial arts? Lu Fan, have you reached the fourth level of body refining?"

Lu Fan was a little surprised that Xun Lao could actually call him by his name. After all, he hadn't been to the library loft for several years.The last time I came here, I took a quick look around and found that there was no possibility of practicing these martial arts, so I left disappointed.

Xun Lao nodded and said: "Yes. Starting from the left hand side, there are sword skills, sword skills, boxing skills, and body skills. On the far right are miscellaneous books, which have not been classified yet. You can choose them yourself. Once you have chosen, bring them to me to register."

Lu Fan bowed in response, and then excitedly began to choose martial arts.

He doesn't want to practice swordsmanship or swordsmanship for the time being.Because the Lu family is strongest in body skills, if you want to learn it, you must first start with body skills and boxing skills. Both of these are hand-to-hand martial arts to strengthen the body. Once practiced, it can be regarded as laying the foundation for cultivating the strongest fire golden body of the Lu family.

Although Lu Fan still had some doubts about whether he could reach the Golden Body of Fire in the future, it was always right to prepare in advance. It was like he had never thought that he would be able to reach the fifth level of body training before the age of eighteen. This was almost the average level of the younger generation of the Lu family.

The world is full of accidents and surprises. Who knows what will happen next moment.

First, he came to the Shenfa Stand and Lu Fan began to select one by one.Most of the body skills here are some basic steps and dodges, and the martial arts skills of horizontal body training are of average effect.Lu Fan had even seen some of them in other people, and they were basically like flower stands.

After picking and choosing, Lu Fan didn't see what he wanted. He couldn't help but feel a little disappointed and could only look at the boxing skills again.

Rolling stone punch, powerful punch, awesome strength......

Just by looking at the names, you can tell that these exercises are very basic.Lu Fan looked through dozens of books and still couldn't find what he was looking for.If he wants to achieve some good results during the New Year Festival, he must now find a martial arts book that is better than others.The fifth level of body refining cannot guarantee that he will not be released. The most critical aspect of the annual festival is the competition.If his martial arts skills are not good, he will be beaten badly by other people of the same level, and the New Year Festival is coming soon, and there is only one month left.

What Lu Fan needs is quick and powerful martial arts.This kind of martial skill is undoubtedly what others dream of, and the possibility of finding it is extremely low.

After searching for almost an hour, Lu Fan couldn't find it.Disappointed, Lu Fan walked back to Xun Lao and said, "Xun Lao, I want to ask you something. Is there no martial arts that can be achieved quickly?"

Xun Lao put down the book in his hand, looked at Lu Fan and said, "Young man, being too ambitious is not the right way to practice martial arts."

Lu Fan nodded and said: "I know. But I really don't have much time. The New Year Festival is in one month. I hope you can understand, Mr. Xun."

Xun Lao looked into Lu Fan's eyes and saw determination in Lu Fan's eyes.

This is an interesting boy!Xun Lao thought to himself.

After a pause, Xunlao said: "There are no martial arts that can be achieved quickly, but generally no one practices this kind of martial arts. Do you want to try it?"

Lu Fan's eyes lit up and he said, "I think so, I really think so."

Xun Lao smiled, stood up, and limped to the pile of miscellaneous books in the corner.Reaching out, Xun Lao pulled out a book with yellowing paper from the bottom of the miscellaneous books.

Walking back staggeringly, Xun Lao handed the book to Lu Fan and said, "Let's take a look."

Lu Fan took the book and saw three big characters.

The name sounds very impressive, and he must have some skills.Lu Fan quickly opened the book and looked at it carefully.

At first glance, his pupils could not help but shrink. No wonder no one practiced it. This martial art was simply made for practicing broken arms.

According to the description in the book, the first thing to do when practicing Bengshan Quan is to use your arms to smash rocks as hard as you can, for eight hours a day, in various postures, and with all your strength, you can achieve success in a month.

Seeing that Lu Fan stopped talking, Xun Lao said with a smile: "How about it, do you want to practice it? This is a high-level human-level martial skill. If you really practice it, you will get results. It will be quite powerful."

Lu Fan gritted his teeth. He was already several years behind others. If he wanted to make up for the gap, it would be impossible without some hardship.

Closing the book, Lu Fan nodded and said, "That's it. Mr. Xun, register it for me. I want it."

"Are you sure? Do you see clearly how you practice?"

Lu Fan said: "You see clearly. There are no shortcuts in martial arts. I think I can bear this bit of hardship."

Xun Lao smiled. It was the first time in so many years that he saw such a perseverant and unafraid person among the younger generation of the Lu family.

Although his strength is average, his mind and courage are quite impressive.

Xun Lao said: "Take it away. This book is given to you, no need to register it."

Lu Fan was stunned for a moment and was about to speak out.At this moment, the door was pushed open again, and a woman walked in, but it was Zhang Yuehan.

At a glance, Zhang Yuehan saw that Lu Fan was also there, and suddenly felt a little embarrassed.

Lu Fan glanced at her, then withdrew his gaze, and said to Xun Lao, "Thank you, Xun Lao, I'll leave first."

Why is he here? Doesn't martial arts require the fourth level of physical training to practice?

Just as he was thinking about it, Mr. Xunlao said, "Girl, what are you doing here? You are not from the Lu family. Outsiders are not allowed to read the library in the attic."

Zhang Yuehan took out a sword from her waist and said, "I'm here to help Lu Ming..."

Before he finished speaking, Xun Lao said: "I can't help anyone, so go out. It's already late at night, go to bed early."

Zhang Yuehan reluctantly walked out of the library loft and stamped her feet unwillingly.

Turning her head, Zhang Yuehan looked at the direction Lu Fan left, thinking a little.

What is he doing here? Aren't martial arts skills required only after the fourth level of body refining?
